# @stolyarovmn/dsh-ui-registry-aggregator 0.5.3-rc.1

Release candidate focused on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.4` compatibility, native Plugin Manager integration, and reliable plugin artwork.

## Fixed

- A transient npm/unpkg/GitHub failure while resolving artwork no longer gets cached as a confirmed "no icon" result. The next refresh can retry immediately instead of preserving a generic icon for the negative-cache TTL.
- Browse artwork resolution now recognizes the current DSH display-resource contract `exports["./icon"]` in addition to the legacy top-level `icon` field.
- DSH `0.2.1` no longer relies on the old `0.2.0-rc.2` DOM polling workaround to expose Registry navigation.

## Native DSH 0.2.1 integration

- `Sources`, `Browse`, and `Updates` register through the official `plugins.tab` root slot exposed by the DSH `0.2.1` Plugin Manager.
- The old DOM bridge remains only as a compatibility fallback for `0.2.0-rc.2`, where the root tab slot was not available.
- The existing `plugins.bundle.config` detail-page surface remains available as a fallback/detail UI.

## Packaging

- Exports `"./icon": "./icon.svg"` and keeps `icon.svg` in the published files.
- Keeps the compatibility range `@deepseek-ai/dsh >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`; isolated install/boot smoke covers the currently tested 0.2.x candidates.
- Prerelease publication uses npm dist-tag `next`; stable releases keep the default npm tag.
- Re-running the release workflow for an already-published version does not republish it.

## Validation

- Repository tests and JavaScript syntax checks pass.
- `npm pack --dry-run` passes.
- Published-artwork probes successfully resolve the existing Registry Aggregator `0.5.2` and Schedule Tab `0.8.0` SVGs from npm/unpkg.
- Isolated install + Web boot smoke passes on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.1-rc.4`.
- Real DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` Chromium validation passed end-to-end: both RC packages load into the native Plugin Manager, `Sources / Browse / Updates` render through `plugins.tab`, both Browse cards resolve SVG data URLs, the native Automation Tasks manager opens, and no plugin/runtime crash is reported.

This is intentionally published as an RC under npm dist-tag `next`; it is not promoted to the stable npm tag.
